description: This file defines the Perl module Git::SVN::Fetcher, which is a subclass of SVN::Delta::Editor. It implements callbacks for processing Subversion tree deltas to store information for git-svn fetch operations, including handling files, directories, properties, and placeholders.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Fetcher
classes.description: A Perl module implementing a subclass of SVN::Delta::Editor to process Subversion deltas for git-svn fetch operations, handling files, directories, properties, and placeholders.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Fetcher object, setting up commit info, options, and internal state.

methods.description: Identifies empty symlinks in the repository, used to handle special symlink cases.

methods.name: in_dot_git
methods.description: Checks if a given path is inside a .git directory.

methods.name: is_path_ignored

methods.description: Opens the root directory.

methods.name: open_directory
methods.description: Opens a directory at a given path.

methods.name: git_path

methods.name: close_file
